title: Field widgets: Grid, DatePicker and RecordPicker act on an Enter pressed while an input method is composing; one IME-key predicate for grid and fields
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Split from #35797 by the seat (PR #35993's acceptance notes list both items; that PR stays on its three widgets). Same class as #35797, under the #35683 inline-edit work.

## What is left

1. **Three more Enter handlers have no composition guard.** Read only, not reproduced, on PR #35993's branch:
   - `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`: the cell `onKeyDown` moves to the next row on Enter.
   - `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/DatePickerField.tsx`: Enter commits the typed date text.
   - `RecordPickerDialog`: Enter in the page-jump box jumps.
2. **Two copies of one predicate.** The grid's `isImeKey` (`@object-ui/components`, from #35747) and `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/imeKey.ts` (from #35993) are byte-identical, and nothing keeps them so.

## Why

A Chinese, Japanese or Korean user who presses Enter to pick a word from the input method also moves the grid field to the next row, commits a half-typed date, or jumps the picker's page. Two hand-kept copies of the guard drift apart the next time one is fixed.

## To do

1. Reproduce each of the three in Chromium with a real composition (CDP `Input.imeSetComposition`), then guard the ones that reproduce; say which did not.
2. Leave one definition of the predicate. Pick its home (an export on the `@object-ui/components` entry, or a lower package both already depend on) and measure `Clause-②` on the built declarations.
3. Pins per widget with a real composition sequence (compositionstart, keydown Enter with `isComposing: true` and keyCode 229, compositionend), Safari's post-composition 229 Enter pinned.

## Acceptance

- In each reproduced widget, an Enter during a composition does only what the input method does with it.
- One predicate in the repository; the grid and the field widgets import it.

Blocked-by: #35993.
Reader: the seat's area thread for derived bugs (b1-DB), `domain:ui`.
